services.desc: Kauai's Ultimate South Shore Zodiac Boat Snorkeling Adventure Embark on a journey through Kauai's mesmerizing marine world with our South Shore Zodiac Boat Snorkeling Adventure. Departing from the sunny shores of Poipu, this ocean experience promises vibrant coral reefs, captivating caves, and an incredible variety of marine life, all narrated with local knowledge from our experienced captain and crew. Why Choose Our South Shore Adventure? Discover Hidden Treasures: Venture to iconic locations including the Queen’s Summer Home at Allerton Bay, the Spouting Horn, and, conditions allowing, the secluded Kipu Kai. services.desc: Embark on Kauai’s Ultimate SOUTH SIDE Whale & Dolphin Zodiac Boat Adventure – A Spectacle of Nature Awaiting Your Discovery! Available Seasonally: November – March Each Year. Experience the Magic with Kauai's Premier Whale Watching Excursions Set forth on an unparalleled adventure with our Whale & Dolphin Zodiac Boat Adventure, exclusively during the prime whale-watching season from late November/early December to March. Be part of a select few to witness the grandeur of the North Pacific Humpback whales, affectionately known as the ocean's "gentle giants," as they journey from the cool Alaskan seas to the welcoming Hawaiian waters.
